standard_prerequisites.use: Provides unramifiedness of the induced morphism of locally closed subschemes.

core_obligations: Representability: an immersion of algebraic stacks is representable, hence DM by the trivial implications (proof lines 8326-8328)
Presentation: base change of the immersion along a smooth surjective morphism from a scheme gives a locally closed subscheme of that scheme (proof lines 8329-8331)

Unramifiedness of the induced morphism of schemes, from the open and the closed immersion cases, and conclusion from the definition of an unramified morphism of algebraic stacks (proof lines 8331-8334)

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an immersion of algebraic stacks is unramified (author lemma at source lines 8320-8323, label lemma-immersion-unramified). The proof (source lines 8325-8335) notes that the immersion is representable hence DM, pulls it back along a smooth surjective presentation to obtain a locally closed subscheme of a scheme, applies the open and closed immersion cases for schemes, and concludes from the definition (proof lines 8326-8334). The verification of the defining clause through a presentation is the content. H2.
